## Problem
The live `completion-verifier` standing eval constructs one PydanticAIRunner before entering its per-case disposable repositories. `eval_solver.run_case` correctly passes a per-case `repo_root`, but the explicit runner override retains its original `LLMConfig.repo_path`. `runner._effective_config` substitutes only the request model, so filesystem and ticket tools read the checkout instead of each case fixture.

## Evidence
A full live run had coverage 1.0 but epoch_pass `[False, False, False]`. Targeted complete cases searched `/Users/joeoakhart/rebar-debug-completion-9895` and cited `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/completion-verifier.eval.yaml`; they did not see fixture files such as `src/cli.py` or `app/profile.py`. Operator-attested cases, which need no fixture code, passed. Code path: `src/rebar/llm/evals/eval.py::_live_solver` builds one runner; `src/rebar/llm/evals/eval_solver.py::run_case` creates the disposable repo; `src/rebar/llm/runner.py::_effective_config` preserves the runner base `repo_path`.

## Plan
- Add a RED eval-solver contract proving an explicitly injected reusable live-style runner reads each disposable case root.
- Re-root the effective per-request config without weakening the run-wide budget/config floor or model override semantics.
- Validate completion, ticket-quality, and spec-alignment disposable-store cases plus ordinary workflow runner reuse.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] A deterministic test reproduces a completion eval reading the wrong checkout root before the fix.
- [x] Every agentic eval case reads its own disposable fixture repository and ticket store.
- [x] Existing per-step model substitution and run-wide floor semantics remain unchanged.
- [x] The full live `completion-verifier` standing eval passes its declared `at_least(2)` gate with coverage at least 0.8.
